reasons.organic_shape: Cell boundaries show good interlocking wavy outlines, though slightly uniform and stiff.
reasons.translucency: Surfaces appear somewhat opaque and clay-like, missing soft internal light scatter.
reasons.lighting_depth: Depth of field is clear, but specular rim lighting and contrast are subtle.
reasons.detail: Basic textures and nuclear bumps are visible, but macro-level membrane micro-detail is limited.
reasons.science: Effectively demonstrates the flat pavement epithelium and particle exchange concept.
reasons.same_class: Presents clean educational medical 3D, but falls short of photorealistic cinematic benchmarks.

route1.biggest_gap: The materials lack wetness and deep subsurface translucency, appearing more like opaque stylized rubber than living organic tissue.

reasons.organic_shape: Cell boundaries exhibit natural interlocking contours with well-defined nuclear domes.
reasons.translucency: Material shaders show convincing subsurface scattering and soft fleshy light penetration.
reasons.lighting_depth: Key and rim lighting create strong separation with appropriate focal blur.
reasons.detail: Fine mottled texturing and moist surface reflections feel organic rather than flat.
reasons.science: Correctly depicts thin flattened morphology and exchange across an epithelial layer.
reasons.same_class: Visual execution matches the target medical-grade macro benchmark standard.

route2.biggest_gap: The floating blue spheres appear slightly detached due to minimal contact shadowing and reflection interaction with the cell surface.
